html:
Sun World Ha Long is a top-notch entertainment area, full of excitement that makes visitors not want to leave. It can be said that this is an international-class entertainment park complex consisting of two main areas: the coastal entertainment complex and the entertainment complex on the top of Ba Deo, connected by a cable car system.

Sun World Ha Long is the leading entertainment area in Ha Long, there are also resorts with famous projects such as Sun World Ba Na Hills, Asia Park, Sun World Fansipan Legend… with exciting games that promise to bring visitors the most ideal vacation in Ha Long.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ha Long, visitors should visit the coastal entertainment complex located on Bai Chay beach, to participate in experiencing interesting games such as: Dragon Park, adventure games with roller coasters, Water Park with the name of Tornado Bay, visitors will immerse themselves on the Ha Long beach with clear blue water like jade.

Experience the cable car route across the sea that will take visitors to the Sun Hill Entertainment Complex, and visit the top of Ba Deo such as Japanese Garden, the indoor game area of ​​the Mysterious Castle, especially the Sun Wheel… an interesting game that visitors cannot miss when coming to Ha Long.

Delicious dishes in Ha Long

When visiting Sun World Ha Long, visitors not only participate in interesting games, but also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, fully satisfying the tastes and satisfying all diners, even the most demanding ones.

When visiting Sun World Park, visitors should experience the Dragon Park with amusement parks such as: Ghost Tunnel, Pottery Village, Canival Game, Monorail, Flying Lizard, Death Wheel…

Water Park with amusement parks such as: Sun Bay, Continuous Tornado, Dragon Riding, Tsunami, Pirate Island…

The cable car will take visitors to amusement parks such as: Sword Forging Village, Samurai Slide Area, Upside Down Land – Magic Land, Wax Museum, Moc Tra Quan… and many other interesting games waiting for visitors to explore.

So, let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ha Long tour today to participate in the exciting games at Sun World Ha Long Park, which will bring visitors the most enjoyable experiences in the island paradise.
